walk_forward.note: Anchored walk-forward using calendar_fold_windows (relativedelta months=6), final fold clipped at eval_end. EVERY fold is an independent backtest run with its own warmup (550 calendar days before fold start) and state initialization. NO curve slicing.

temporal_execution_note: EVERY temporal window is independently executed with its own warmup and state initialization. Exclude windows are CHAINED runs: segment 2 warms up on all bars before its start (including excluded year) and compounds on segment 1 ending equity. NO curve slicing.

E0.label: CONTROL
E0.description: Current V3. Weekly entries. Weekly exits only. No daily revalidation.

E1.label: DAILY_TOP8_EXIT
E1.description: Weekly entries unchanged. On every completed daily bar: if held symbol is no longer V3-qualified OR its V3 alpha rank >8: exit at next tradable open. No replacement until next weekly rebalance. Early exits create CASH.

E2.label: DAILY_TOP12_HOLD_BAND
E2.description: Weekly entries unchanged. On every completed daily bar: if symbol is no longer V3-qualified OR V3 alpha rank >12: exit at next tradable open. Rank 9-12 acts as hold hysteresis band. No replacement until weekly rebalance.

E3.label: CONFIRMED_TOP12_BREAKDOWN
E3.description: Same as E2 except rank>12/unqualified condition must persist for TWO consecutive completed daily bars. Then exit at next tradable open.

exit_execution_semantics.entry_policy: FROZEN: new positions ONLY at normal weekly V3 scheduled decision (RebalancePolicy weekly). No intraday/daily entries, no replacement before next weekly, no top_n/size/allocation change.
exit_execution_semantics.daily_information: At every completed daily bar, construct exact V3 cross-section using only information through that completed bar. Reuse production V3 scoring: positive 12-1 gate -> 6/9/12 raw residual percentile consensus -> ivol eligibility -> V3 alpha rank. Use PIT eligible candidate pool. Do NOT rank only 30 streamed names. No lookahead.
exit_execution_semantics.execution: If exit condition fires on day T close (completed bar), execution at next tradable bar/open using production cost model (slippage 2bps + half spread 1bps + effective-dated equity fees). No same-bar exit.
exit_execution_semantics.cash_handling: Early exits create CASH until next scheduled V3 rebalance. No re-entry intra-week.

entry_policy_note: ALL candidates use EXACTLY current V3 entry behavior. Verification: weekly scheduled decisions must equal CONTROL on same timestamps disregarding intermediate exits.

cost_stress.description: Each level independently RERUNS the full trading path with scaled engine cost inputs: slippage_bps*MULT, spread_bps*MULT, crypto_taker_fee_bps*MULT, and where applicable equity fee rates scaled similarly. No heuristic adjustments such as adjusted_return = base_return - estimated_fee or adjusted_sharpe = base_sharpe * constant. Real fills at scaled adverse prices generate real turnover/fee differences.
forbidden_heuristics: any linear fee subtraction without rerun

fold_contract.integrity: EVERY fold is an independent backtest run. No fast_folds_from_curve, no equity-curve slicing.

promotion_rubric.description: A candidate passes ONLY if ALL 12 criteria are true (§10).
criteria: 2. Full-period total return not worse by more than 5pp vs CONTROL (candidate_return >= control_return - 0.05).

3. MaxDD improves by >=1.5 percentage points (candidate_maxDD <= control_maxDD - 0.015) OR worst-position contemporaneous-account loss improves >=25% without increasing maxDD (candidate_worst_pos_acct_loss >= control_worst_pos_acct_loss * 0.75 and candidate_maxDD <= control_maxDD).
4. net_early_exit_value > 0 where net = avoided_post_exit_loss - premature_exit_opportunity_cost - incremental_transaction_costs.
5. Median paired 20-fold return delta (candidate - control per fold) >= 0.
6. >=10/20 Sharpe folds beat CONTROL (candidate Sharpe > control Sharpe in at least 10 folds).
8. 3x real cost rerun preserves the advantage (at 3x, Sharpe >= CONTROL 3x and return delta >= -0.05 and maxDD not worse by >1pp).

9. No one-year dependency (every single calendar year 2017-2026 candidate not dominated; worst single-year delta not worse than -10pp and exclude-2020 and exclude-2024 windows still satisfy criteria 1,2,3 at least).

10. No one-symbol dependency (candidate-specific jackknife: dropping candidate's own top-3 combined positive-PnL contributors, candidate return still >= CONTROL -5pp and Sharpe still >= CONTROL -0.05 and maxDD not materially worse).

11. Early-exit turnover does not increase by >50% unless Sharpe and maxDD both materially improve (if turnover_increase >0.50 then require candidate Sharpe > control Sharpe +0.05 AND candidate maxDD < control maxDD -0.015).
12. No lookahead (daily cross-section uses only completed bar; verified by construction and test).

definitions.avoided_post_exit_loss: Aggregate MAE after candidate early-exit point that was avoided: sum over early-exited episodes of (control_exit_price - candidate_exit_price)/entry_price * qty normalized to account equity, but only when control went further adverse after exit. Implemented as total adverse movement after candidate exit that control experienced, floored at 0.
definitions.premature_exit_opportunity_cost: Aggregate opportunity foregone when early exit was followed by recovery before control exit: sum of positive control recovery after candidate exit that was missed.
definitions.net_early_exit_value: avoided_post_exit_loss - premature_exit_opportunity_cost - incremental_transaction_costs (incremental fees+slippage+spread vs CONTROL full-period).
definitions.incremental_transaction_costs: candidate_total_costs - control_total_costs (real rerun costs, not estimated).

promotion_rubric.verdict: If no candidate passes all 12, verdict is DAILY EXIT REVALIDATION REJECTED. No new thresholds (top10/top14 etc.) may be tested after. Conclude and move to position-sizing / ex-ante tail-risk research.

forbidden_shortcuts: temporal slicing from a full-period curve
any heuristic fee transformation without rerun
